# <span id="aanchor58"></span> Report Categories

Report categories are used to create groupings of reports that will be available in the Standard Reports screen. User or group access to these categories can then be granted/restricted from the [Reports Access](Report%20Access.md) screen.

If TESTit 3 Integrated is enabled, the TESTit category and reports will not display; these items will only be available from the TESTit application.

<div class="procedure">

To create a report category:

1.  Go to **Reports** \> **Standard Reports**.

2.  Select **Report** \> **Category** from the Standard Reports menu.

    Each report is labeled as "L" (liquid), "G" (gas), or "B" (both).

3.  In the Report Categories screen, go to **File** \> **New** or right-click the empty space and select **New**.

4.  Enter a name for the category.

5.  Drag and drop one or more reports from the Available Reports list to the new category.

6.  Go to **File** \> **Save** or right-click the empty space and select **Save**. The category with the associated reports will now be available from the Standard Reports screen.
